_comment: Every song the harmony panel offers, and the names she answers to. Adding a song is an entry here plus its folder; nothing in the code needs to change.
_dir_note: dir is the folder under source/harmony holding manifest.json, contours.json, lyrics.json, lyrics_en.txt and the part recordings. Lupang Hinirang has dir "" because its files sit directly in source/harmony, where the consoles on 5173 and 5174 still read them from — moving them would break those.
_ready_note: ready false means the song is listed but has no recordings yet: the panel shows it greyed out and she says she cannot sing it rather than starting something silent.
_aliases_note: How the song might be ASKED for, including what speech recognition tends to hear. Matched longest-first, so a two-word name wins over a one-word one it contains.

songs.title: Silent Night
songs._parts_note: All four parts recorded. Measured by scripts/analyze_harmony.py: they agree within 0.12s, and the opening notes make a B flat major chord - B flat in the bass, D in the alto, F in the soprano.

songs.title: Bahay Kubo
songs._parts_note: Soprano C5 and alto E4. The alto was sung along to the soprano, which is why they line up: 0.00s offset, each third of the song within a quarter second. Trimmed 0.73s at the front - the soprano take was cut after its first note had started and the alto was not - and at 28.93s where the singing ends. Levels lifted to 0.21 and 0.20, from 0.12 and 0.14. The alto tracks about three times less cleanly than the soprano (median pitch spread 18 against 6), which shows in the live chart but not in playback. No phrase boundaries: the alto sustains through the soprano's breaths, so the two share no rest.
